title: WHAT IS NEW CARD: NOTE LINES SAY MORE THAN THE HEADLINE, X ABOVE THE TITLE RULE
why: After the last ship the card read polish pass 31. with nothing after it, and its X ran across the title rule.
now: Each note line keeps its first clause after the headline. The X is smaller and sits above the title rule.

edits.replacement: var _wxs=LH(32), _wxx=wnX+wnW-LH(14)-_wxs, _wxy=wnY+LH(10);   // v28.xx (cw-endrow2): the X (32 to 42 down) ends above the title rule (44 down); it ran across the rule at 40
